summary: Constrain control-plane outbound endpoints and development mint file names
details: Control-plane startup and outbound requests now reject non-HTTP endpoints, embedded URL credentials, URL fragments, and surrounding whitespace while retaining operator-configured remote HTTP and HTTPS RPC targets.
The shared HTTP client no longer follows redirects, so a configured service cannot redirect probes or authenticated Bitcoin RPC calls to another endpoint.
World-sim wallet names used for development mint payload files are bounded to 64 bytes and an ASCII identifier alphabet before any file is written.
